en.headline: Silver Bond allotment hits records; up to 13 lots per investor
en.dek: The government received 476,703 applications totalling HK$119.3 billion for the 11th batch, and raised the final issuance to HK$55 billion.
body: The latest batch of Silver Bonds drew record applications and subscription amounts, the government announced on Friday, with successful applicants receiving up to 13 lots each.

A total of 476,703 valid applications sought HK$119.3 billion of the three-year bonds, more than double the final issuance size of HK$55 billion. The original target had been HK$50 billion. The bonds carry a guaranteed annual coupon of 4.25 percent and are intended for investors born on or before 31 December 1967.

Investors who applied for 12 lots or fewer will receive their full request. Those who sought more will first receive 12 lots, with a ballot deciding who obtains an additional lot. More than 97,000 applicants are expected to receive the extra allocation. Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the figures reflected the popularity of the bonds as a safe investment option for the elderly.

zh.headline: 第11批銀債配發結果出爐 最多可獲13手
zh.dek: 政府公布認購申請476,703份、總額1,193億元均創紀錄，最終發行額加至550億元。
body: 政府周五公布第11批銀色債券認購及配發結果，申請人數及認購金額均創歷史新高，成功申請人最多可獲配發13手。
有效申請共476,703份，申請本金總額達1,193.06億元，超過最終發行額550億元一倍有多。原定目標發行額為500億元。債券為期三年，保證年息4.25厘，合資格申請人須於1967年12月31日或之前出生。
認購12手或以下的申請人將全數獲配；認購超過12手的申請人先獲12手，再經抽籤決定誰獲額外1手，預計超過9.7萬人可多得一手。財政司司長陳茂波表示，數字反映銀色債券作為安全穩定投資選項繼續受長者歡迎。
